The engine's fixed-capacity curves at b2e5757, for the plan §4.5 change on the measured S* (2026-11-11).
Not a gate run: seeds 9001-9010 only (1-20 are the gate's, 21-40 reserved).

Method. "freeze": TestFreeze's measureCurve (freeze_test.go) at each seed, unchanged: n = 1..maxN via Config.Fixed,
each run p.length long (1800 s for the drain plants, 300 s for the others), the first p.warmup (300 s / 60 s) dropped;
S* by target(), linear between the bracketing whole n. "gke-protocol": the drain plant (drainHeavy, 3000 ms CPU then
28500 ms wait, jitter 0.1, 250m, Procs 2) at n = 1..10, each run 2100 s with the first 300 s dropped (the GKE runs'
protocol, hack/rlgov-measure/results/curve-settings.txt), seeds 9001-9010; per n the mean of the ten run means, their
between-run sd, the mean X and the mean CPU per completion (U/X); then each drain seed's U at n = 1..10 under both
protocols, with every crossing of rho*L (target() takes the first). Produced by TestCurveDiag (curvediag_test.go):
SIM_CURVEDIAG=1 go test ./pkg/ratelimit/internal/costmodel/sim/ -run 'TestCurveDiag$' -count=1 -v
The output is deterministic: a re-run at the same code reproduces every line.
